## Description

Please include a summary of the change and the motivation behind it. Reference any related issues if applicable.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧹 Code refactoring or cleanup
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Test suite addition or improvement

## Verification Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please ensure the following checks pass locally:

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` reports zero diffs
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` reports zero warnings
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes with 0 failures
- [ ] Any new public APIs or modules include doc comments
- [ ] If applicable, relevant unit or integration tests have been added
